incidents.name: Zeed Finance YEED reflection skim drain
incidents.notes: The YEED token's reflection accounting credits a fee share to every holder on transfer without syncing the pairs, so cycling skim() between the YEED pairs inflated their YEED balances and let the attacker swap the accumulated YEED out for the pools' USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: YEED 0xe7748FCe1D1e2f2Fd2dDdB5074bD074745dDa8Ea created 2022-04-20T05:46:12Z by 0x9765912d6d1848f155914e2b84b4d80661eb5337, unrelated to attack sender 0xec14207d56e10f72446576779d9b843e476e0fb0; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 187,555.56 + 711,623.95 + 142,848.96 = 1,042,028.46 USDT left the three YEED pools into the attack contract in the exploit transaction.
